FN-B8PNJJ4-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 253
Committee: Ports, Waterways & Intermodal Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Transit
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/06/2024
House Bill 253 as reported by the Committee on Ports, Waterways & Intermodal Transit could
increase or decrease the obligations of the State Port Authority by an undetermined amount,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, dependent on the difference in: (1) the compensation of any
non-merit employees hired pursuant to this bill; and (2) the compensation otherwise provided to
merit employees under current law.
This bill would also codify the current practice of the Authority to require it to pay the State
Employees Insurance Fund employer contributions.
